phrase.en: A small contribution can support growth.

visual.zh: 大幅裁切的深绿陶碗在左侧碗沿托住一滴乳白色液体，浅绿内壁与左上浅色空白形成安静的对照。黑白版保持液滴与碗沿的接触以及大小关系。
visual.en: A small cream-white bead rests on the left rim of a large cropped dark green bowl. Its pale celadon interior contrasts with the quiet upper-left field. The neutral edition preserves the bead’s contact with the rim and the scale difference.

background.zh:
霍普金斯获1929年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖的一半，因发现促进生长的维生素。他的历史研究表明，食物的作用不能只由蛋白质、脂肪、碳水化合物等主要成分解释，还需少量附加因素。乳白液滴借用相关研究中的牛奶线索，表达少量因素的作用，并非维生素外形或现代饮食建议；短句为原创。
1929年生理学或医学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他发现促进生长的维生素。
background.en:
Hopkins received half of the 1929 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering growth-stimulating vitamins. His historical research showed that major food components alone did not explain growth; small accessory factors also mattered. The cream-white bead draws on milk used in that research as a metaphor for a small contribution, not the appearance of a vitamin or modern dietary advice. The phrase is original.
1929 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his discovery of the growth-stimulating vitamins
